> 第23章 除夕夜话一（第1页）
"这个，我还真的没有去想过。毕竟我现在实力低微，事情都不由我做主，想再多也没用。还是先把提高实力再说吧!"江流略带无奈的说道。"哈哈!你小子倒是实在。是啊!在这世上，没有实力，一切终究是空!你年纪还小，一切还是以提升实力为要，别想那么多有的无的。""是的!海叔，来，我们干!""哈哈!还是跟你喝酒痛快!不像林海那小子，老是偷奸耍滑的。"这时，门口突然传来一道声音:"海叔，你说谁偷奸耍滑呢?可不能背后说人坏话啊!"只见林海手里提着几瓶酒，走了进来。"是你小子啊!你今年可是来晚了啊!"海叔笑着看着林海说道。"今年有点事耽搁了，还好也不算很晚，再说了，今年不是还有江流陪着您老嘛!""哈哈!你这滑头!怎么了?不是啥大事吧?"海叔脸带关心的说道。"不是什么大事，已经处理好了。来，我们继续喝!别管那些不开心的事了。"林海举着酒瓶说道。江流连忙接过，放在了桌子上。林海坐下一看，惊讶地说道:"海叔，你想开啦!连这个陈年珍酿都拿出来喝了?""是啊!多得江小子提醒了我一句，才让我幡然醒悟。今天就今朝有酒今朝醉了，我们来个不醉不归!""哪里，哪里，我也是有感而发而儿，可能我年纪小，想的没那么长远!""今日就借花敬佛，多谢海叔平日对我多有照顾。多谢林大头目对于我的帮助，小子感激不尽，这杯敬你们!"江流端起酒杯道。"你小子倒是滑头，拿我珍藏的好酒当人情啊!想谢，改天你自己买好酒来谢!"海叔故作不满的说道。"就是!哪有那么好的事。今天的酒，都是我跟海叔出的。想谢你得自己张罗去。"林海也跟着附和道。江流嘻笑道:"那等我他日有空，寻到几瓶好酒，再来感谢两位?""哈哈!你这滑头小子，老夫差你那点酒喝?赶紧坐下!继续喝!"海叔手指江流笑着说道。"就是，让你请!那不是显得我们欺负后辈吗?今天你别想着逃，来，一起干了再说!"林海举杯说道。三人把杯中酒喝完，接着就开始慢酌起来。"海叔，我对于江湖中事不太了解，您老能跟我说说吗?让我解解惑!"江流一脸好奇地对着海叔说道。"江湖啊!怎么说呢？能不踏入，还是不踏入的好。只是我们现在就处于江湖之中，怎么还可能说不踏入就不踏入呢?"海叔一脸唏嘘的说道。"至于江湖事，这个真没什么好说的。你要谨记一条:凡事皆因强出头!碰到任何事!三思而后行!"海叔一脸教诲的说道。江流一脸受教地点了点头。说明这句话记到了心里去了。也是啊!想着自己之前如果强出头，好几次碰到的情况，自己能不能活到现在都还是未知数呢？"江湖上流传的三宗四派六世家，七教八谷十名流，你应该听说过吧!""这个还是海叔之前跟我说的!"江流回道。"哦!这个我说的啊!忘了!那你知道是哪三宗四派六世家，七教八谷十名流吗?""这个我知道!我来说说!"林海一脸兴奋的说道。"行!你来给江流说说吧!""所谓三宗就是大乾王朝的三大超级宗门!超级宗门都是有极境宗师实力坐镇的!这三宗分别就是流云宗，昊天宗，星月宗!""这三宗，每宗弟子都有几十万!几乎遍布整个大乾王朝!如果不是三宗之间互相制衡，只怕大乾王朝的百姓都只知道三宗，而不知道王朝了!""排在后面的，四派就是佛门，道门，儒门，鬼门，这四大门派。这几个门派不用多说，你单看名字就知道了。""只有鬼门特殊点，是修炼鬼派武学的!这门派最是神秘，很少出现在世人面前。这四派，每个门派都至少有三位以上的大宗师坐镇，不然没法跟三宗相抗衡!""再下来的就是六大世家了，这六大世家渊源流长，大乾王朝成立之初就已经存在了。""虽然，现在说是有点落寞了。但是瘦死的骆驼比马大，每个世家最少都有一到二位大宗师撑着。至于究竟有多少大宗师?还有没有极境宗师?就无从知晓了"

The latest chapter of Saint: Suppressing Thirteen Prefectures with One Knife_Chapter 23 New Year's Eve Chapter 1 Page 1_Sage: Suppressing Thirteen Prefectures with One Knife has a long road ahead_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 23 New Year’s Eve Episode 1 (Page 1)
"I really haven't thought about this. After all, my strength is low now, and things are not decided by me. It's useless no matter how much I think about it. Let's talk about improving my strength first!" Jiang Liu said with a hint of helplessness. "Haha! You are a real kid. That's right! In this world, without strength, everything is in vain! You are still young, so everything is still about improving your strength. Don't think so much about what you have and what you don't have." "Yes! Uncle Hai, come, let's do it!" "Haha! Still! I want to have a good time drinking with you! It’s not like that kid Lin Hai, who is always cheating and cheating. "At this time, a voice suddenly came from the door: "Uncle Hai, who are you talking about cheating and cheating? You can't say bad things about people behind their backs!" I saw Lin Hai walking in with a few bottles of wine in his hand. "It's you boy! You came late this year!" Uncle Hai looked at Lin Hai and said with a smile. "Some things have been delayed this year, but fortunately it's not too late. Besides, Jiang Liu will be with you this year!" "Haha! You're such a slick guy! What's wrong? It's not a big deal, is it?" Uncle Hai said with concern on his face. "It's not a big deal, it's been taken care of. Come on, let's keep drinking! Don't worry about those unhappy things." Lin Hai said, holding up the bottle. Jiang Liu quickly took it and put it on the table. Lin Hai sat down and looked at it, and said in surprise: "Uncle Hai, are you thinking! You even took out this old wine to drink?" "Yes! It took a little reminder from Mr. Jiang to make me wake up. Today I have wine to get drunk today, let's not get drunk again!" "Where? , No, I just felt it. Maybe I'm young and don't think that far ahead!" "Today I borrow flowers to pay homage to Buddha. Thank you Uncle Hai for taking care of me. Thank you to Boss Lin for helping me. I'm very grateful. I'd like to toast you with this!" Jiang Liu picked up the wine glass and said. "You're such a naughty boy, you're taking my precious wine as a favor! If you want to thank me, buy some good wine yourself some other time!" Uncle Hai said pretending to be dissatisfied. "That's right! How can such a good thing happen? Today's wine was all paid for by Uncle Hai and I. If I want to thank you, I have to do it myself." Lin Hai also agreed. Jiang Liu laughed and said, "Then when I have time someday and find a few bottles of good wine, I can thank you two again?" "Haha! You naughty boy, I don't want you to drink that little wine? Sit down quickly! Keep drinking!" Uncle Hai pointed at Jiang Liu and said with a smile. "That's right, I asked you to invite me! Doesn't that make it look like we are bullying the younger generation? Don't think about escaping today, come here and do it together!" Lin Hai raised his glass and said. The three of them finished the wine in their glasses and then started drinking slowly. "Uncle Hai, I don't know much about things in Jianghu. Can you always tell me about it? Let me clear up the confusion!" Jiang Liu said to Uncle Hai with a curious look on his face. "The rivers and lakes! How should I put it? It's better not to step into the rivers and lakes. It's just that we are in the rivers and lakes now, how can we say that we won't step in if we don't step in?" Uncle Hai said with a sigh on his face. "As for the Jianghu matter, there really isn't much to say about it. You have to remember one thing: everything is done because of force! Think twice before you act in any situation!" Uncle Hai said with an instructive look on his face. Jiang Liu nodded with a learned expression. It shows that this sentence has been remembered in my heart. That's right! Thinking about the situations that I encountered several times if I had forced myself to stand out, it is still unknown whether I can survive until now? "You should have heard of the three sects, four sects and six aristocratic families, seven sects, eight valleys and ten celebrities spread in the world!" "Uncle Hai told me this before!" Jiang Liu replied. "Oh! I said this! Forgot! Then do you know which are the three sects, four sects, six aristocratic families, seven sects, eight valleys and ten celebrities?" "I know this! Let me tell you!" Lin Hai said with excitement. "Okay! You come and give itJiang Liu, tell me!" "The so-called three sects are the three super sects of the Daqian Dynasty! The super sects all have the strength of extreme masters! These three sects are Liuyun Sect, Haotian Sect, and Xingyue Sect!" "Each of these three sects has hundreds of thousands of disciples! Almost all over the Daqian Dynasty! If it were not for the checks and balances between the three sects, the people of the Daqian Dynasty would only know the three sects and not the dynasty!" "The four sects at the back are Buddhism, Taoism, Confucianism, and Ghost Sect. It goes without saying much about these sects, you can tell just by looking at their names. ""The only special thing about the Ghost Sect is that they practice Ghost Sect martial arts! This sect is the most mysterious and rarely appears in front of the world. Each of these four sects has at least three great masters, otherwise they will not be able to compete with the three sects!" "The next one comes down to the six aristocratic families. These six aristocratic families have a long history and have existed since the founding of the Daqian Dynasty. ""Although, I feel a little lonely now. But a skinny camel is bigger than a horse, and every family has at least one or two great masters to support it. As for how many great masters there are? Are there any extreme masters? There is no way of knowing."
